how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-thousand-needles-03-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1120:details:0: We need to try the ⟦E1⟧ on one of the pit crews. If you want to try it on the gnomes, then here -- take the stout and give it to the gnome pit boss.
rows.quest:1120:details:1: And don't wait too long. This stout will go bad eventually.
rows.quest:1120:progress:0: Hi! You have something for me?
rows.quest:1120:completion:1: We shouldn't be drinking with the race coming up, but... maybe my boys could do with just a little. Besides, it can't be that strong, can it?
rows.quest:1121:details:0: We need to try the ⟦E1⟧ on one of the pit crews. If you want to try it on the goblins, then here -- take the stout and give it to the goblin pit boss.
rows.quest:1121:details:1: And don't wait too long. This stout will go bad eventually.
rows.quest:1121:completion:0: What do we have here? Booze, eh?
rows.quest:1121:completion:1: Well, I don't mind if we have just a little...
rows.quest:1122:details:0: That ⟦E1⟧ worked great! I placed a bet on the next race, and... let's hope the crew you got drunk did a number on their car!
rows.quest:1122:details:1: There's only one more task for you -- take this note back to ⟦E4⟧ in ⟦E5⟧. He'll want to know of the successful test.
rows.quest:1122:details:2: And hopefully we can get more of that ⟦E1⟧ for future races!
rows.quest:1122:progress:0: Hello ⟦1⟧. How'd that stout work out? It's strong stuff, isn't it?
rows.quest:1122:completion:0: It says here that the fool's stout was a success. That's good news!
rows.quest:1122:completion:1: If you ever want more of the stuff, then let me know and I'll have you gather more of ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:2769:obj:0: Speak with ⟦E7⟧ in the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:2769:details:0: Have you met the Brassbolts brothers? They're over in the Shimmering Flats, in ⟦E8⟧, racing their rocket car against the goblins. They usually win which is no surprise--the goblin car blows up so much it barely ever crosses the finish line!
rows.quest:2769:details:1: But even then, the Brassbolts brothers are always looking for new ways to make their car go faster, and Wizzle told me he needs a very rare component for his next experiment.
rows.quest:2769:details:2: He probably needs help getting that part. Speak to him and find out.
rows.quest:2769:completion:0: Ah, you want to help me? Great!
rows.quest:2769:completion:1: There's a part I want for an experiment I'm working on, and I need a brave ⟦2⟧ like you to help me get it!
